name: ntr_region_dd
xsql:
SELECT Region_Name, Region_Value 
FROM (
    SELECT 'ALL' AS Region_Name, 'ALL' AS Region_Value FROM DUAL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT Region AS Region_Name, Region AS Region_Value 
    FROM EXT_NATERA_TERRITORY_MAP
    WHERE ('ALL' IN (:p_ta) OR Division IN (:p_ta))
) 
ORDER BY CASE WHEN Region_Name = 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, Region_Name
